title: The convergence contract, and every path that has to inherit it
note: require_converged was written for run_coupled and applied there. For a long time those were the ONLY TWO call sites in the repository, while run_mode_sequence_3d -- whose own docstring says it runs the canonical mode order 'exactly mirroring the 1D/2D coupled_mode_solver' -- mirrored the mode order, the state hand-off and the species interlocks, and not this. The tests that existed asserted the helper rejects a hand-made object with solver_status='failed'; that proves the function works and says nothing about whether anything calls it, which was the defect. SC1-SC3 attack the 3D call sites, SC4-SC5 the two halves of the contract itself, SC6 the energy accounting that quadratured an extrapolation over a failed solve, SC7 a reduction check taken outside the sequence.

mutations.name: SC1_the_3d_MODE_B_solve_is_not_checked
mutations.rationale: restores the defect at the first solve: everything downstream -- Mode C, readiness, the campaign state, the falsification report, the machine FSM -- is built on an integration nobody asked about

mutations.name: SC2_the_3d_MODE_C_solve_is_not_checked
mutations.find:
tC = require_converged(
        solve_thermal_3d(cfg, g3, source_mode="averaged", source_scale=0.0,
mutations.rationale: Mode C decides readiness and Mode D is constructed only if it holds, so a non-converged recovery solve that still yields a recool time is a readiness verdict taken from an integration that did not finish

mutations.name: SC3_the_3d_MODE_D_hold_is_not_checked
mutations.rationale: the sensing-hold thermal state; a hold nobody integrated to completion is not a hold

mutations.name: SC4_the_contract_accepts_any_status
mutations.find:
status = getattr(result, "solver_status", None)
    if status != SOLVER_OK:
mutations.rationale: the contract itself goes quiet, and every call site inherits a check that checks nothing

mutations.name: SC5_a_truncated_trajectory_is_accepted
mutations.rationale: a failed integration returns a SHORTER trajectory, every value finite, so assert_finite passes and a caller pairing so.y with its t_eval holds two arrays of different lengths

mutations.name: SC6_the_energy_accounting_extrapolates_over_a_failed_solve
mutations.find:
"residual_J": residual if converged else float("nan"),
        "rel_residual": (residual / denom) if converged else float("nan"),
mutations.rationale: the accounting quadratures the solver's interpolant over the whole window; past the interval actually integrated an OdeSolution extrapolates rather than refusing, so a failed solve reports an ordinary-looking closure residual

mutations.name: SC7_a_reduction_check_compares_against_a_non_answer
mutations.rationale: these solves are taken outside run_mode_sequence_3d, so enforcing it there does not reach them; the comparison then measures the distance between one answer and one non-answer and reports a rel_error with a within_tolerance verdict
